channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tyler Herro | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tyler Herro from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony on Tyler Herro and Bam Adebayo altercation:

“We was just in a bunker for eight years... We done went to war for eight seasons... The minute that you leave, you put that out there... So that told me that was brewing and what we were building wasn't real… so if you went out there to told somebody you don't even know this information, that told me that I got to approach you the way that I feel like is the best way because if you don't stop it right away, it keeps going.”

Carmelo Anthony on Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro, Jul 27, 2026. Source: Youtube.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro:

“He's still day to day and I don't have an exact date when he'll be ready.”

Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro, Jan 4, 2026. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Norman Powell, Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro
item.description:
“Y’all know how good Norman is. He was an All-Star this year out there in the West. So for the Heat to be able to get a player like that with Bam [Adebayo], with Tyler [Herro] as the No. 1 and No. 2 options, all right. Let’s go.”

Dwyane Wade on Norman Powell, Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro, Jul 16, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro's decision to take a three instead of taking the transition layup in the final seconds:

“Here’s what I’ll say is Tyler has a fearlessness that you can’t take for granted. He’s hit so many big shots. He wants to take on anything to help you win and he’s had a lot of big plays offensively, especially in fourth quarters in his time with us. And it’s my job now to also coach him in situational basketball.”

Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro, Apr 10, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Jimmy Butler, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Bam Adebayo on having to take on a bigger role along with Tyler Herro in Jimmy Butler's absence:

“This is our opportunity. We’ve always had little stints of this. But this is our opportunity right now.”

Bam Adebayo on Jimmy Butler, Tyler Herro, Apr 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Klay Thompson:

“It helps when they’re missing their elite scorers like Jimmy and Herro.”

Klay Thompson on Tyler Herro, Mar 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Jimmy Butler, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Terry Rozier on playing next to Butler-Bam-Herro:

“I’m not here to step on anybody’s toes. Obviously I wanna be me. I’m just here to contribute and help this team get over that hump. That’s what I want to do.”

Terry Rozier on Jimmy Butler, Tyler Herro, Jan 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Duncan Robinson on his role with Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro returning:

“The mindset shifts a little bit maybe just with the role change. But in the grand scheme of things, just try to keep everything the same. When I'm out there, play the same way. Be assertive, aggressive and play with confidence.”

Duncan Robinson on Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro, Dec 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Pat Riley on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Pat Riley on Tyler Herro:

“We missed him (in the playoffs). People don't understand just how lethal he is. He gets bigger in the biggest moments. We've got two anchors in Bam and Tyler.”

Pat Riley on Tyler Herro, Jun 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro:

“It’s all hands on deck. We’re going with our normal rotation, and then we’ll see how things play out.”

Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro, Jun 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Michael Malone on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Nuggets coach Michael Malone on the potential return of Tyler Herro:

“To be honest, it doesn't change anything.... Our approach is the same, our game plan is the same.”

Michael Malone on Tyler Herro, Jun 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on the main changes without Tyler Herro moving forward:

“A lot. You can't fully make-up what Tyler has been for our team all year long.”

Jimmy Butler on Tyler Herro, Apr 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro being out:

“You just never know with ankle sprains. They’re just never on your timeline. He just doesn’t have the mobility yet.”

Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro, Nov 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Mike Brown on Tyler Herro
item.description:
“He traveled on the last play and I would not be doing my job if I didn’t come up here and protect my guys. My guys fought their behind off for close to 48 minutes, and to (see Herro) pump fake and then sidestep, or hop and then one-two and a shot, and not make that call, to me it’s just unbelievable.”

Mike Brown on Tyler Herro, Nov 3, 2022. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Mike Brown on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Brown made his feelings clear during his postgame news conference, saying he felt Heat guard Tyler Herro traveled before making a game-winning 3-pointer with 1.8 seconds remaining.

“We’ve got a lot of respect for the program, the Miami Heat, (coach Erik) Spoelstra and everything they’ve done, and Tyler Herro’s a great player, but he traveled,”

Mike Brown on Tyler Herro, Nov 3, 2022. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Kevin Love on Tyler Herro
item.description:
#Cavs Kevin Love on possibly winning 6MOY:

“Tyler Herro, he was an All-Star off the bench, so I wasn't mad at being a runner up to him. Definitely would mean a lot, especially being w/ this group. Understanding that I was able to take on a different role & still be effective”

Kevin Love on Tyler Herro, Sep 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Bam Adebayo on Tyler Herro Injury:

“He’s our spark off the bench, so I feel like he would have made a big difference. He’s our spark off the bench. He can get it going in a hurry. We missed that aspect. But like I said, we fought through adversity before. We fought being No. 1 in the East with a whole bunch of guys out and still staying No. 1 in the East.”

Bam Adebayo on Tyler Herro, May 30, 2022. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro’s injury:

“I kinda had an idea when we were leaving that he needed rest and recovery.”

Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro, May 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Payton Pritchard on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Jay King:Payton Pritchard on the back and forth with Tyler Herro:

“I think that’s just part of basketball. It’s a competitive sport. … That’s all it is.”

Payton Pritchard on Tyler Herro, May 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Trae Young, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Barry Jackson:Haslem on Herro:

“People were like, ‘I was crazy to co-sign Tyler being in the conversation with Luka and Trae Young.’ People thought I was crazy to co-sign. I was like, ‘I’m not crazy. I know what I see.'”

Udonis Haslem on Trae Young, Tyler Herro, Mar 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Malik Monk on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Malik Monk on battling back and forth with Tyler Herro:

“He's a great player. He's always knocking tough shots down and things like that, butI'm trying to kill everybody in front of me.”

Malik Monk on Tyler Herro, Nov 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro adapting to his new role:

“He's continuing to process things and put them into his computer, and he's making better and better plays for us even in this young season.”

Erik Spoelstra on Tyler Herro, Dec 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Pat Riley on Jimmy Butler, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Five Reasons Sports Network: Pat Riley on Tyler Herro:

“How he grew, he grew through listening. He grew through the mentorship of Udonis, Jimmy Butler, Goran, Andre... All these veterans took him under their wing, because they saw something special in him.”

Pat Riley on Jimmy Butler, Tyler Herro, Oct 23, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: LeBron James on Tyler Herro, Anthony Davis
item.description:
Lakers’ LeBron James on Anthony Davis’s defensive length after Finals Game 4 win over Heat:

“I mean, s—-, Did you see how high (Tyler) Herro threw that ball up? It went in, but he had to throw that thing up to the skyscrapers, right? The guy can do everything defensively.”

LeBron James on Tyler Herro, Anthony Davis, Oct 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Jay King:Brad Stevens:

“Herro was ridiculously good tonight. The rim must have looked like the ocean to him.”

Brad Stevens on Tyler Herro, Sep 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Heat Nation:Goran Dragic on Tyler Herro:

“He's tremendous for us. He made that clutch 3 for us. He's just a competitor. He's not afraid of the big moments and we love him for that. ... Man he's gonna be scary.”

Goran Dragic on Tyler Herro, Sep 16, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Ben Simmons, Duncan Robinson, Kendrick Nunn, Tyler Herro
item.description:
one Western Conference coach told HoopsHype.

“I think Simmons is more versatile. I’d just surround him with shooters and open the floor up like Milwaukee for Giannis. There can be more creativity with Simmons on the offensive end. I would try to trade Embiid to Miami and get some of their young, hungry shooters and guards like Tyler Herro, Kendrick Nunn, Duncan Robinson, etc. Ideally, I’d get Bam, but I doubt Miami would trade him.”

Joel Embiid on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Ben Simmons, Duncan Robinson, Kendrick Nunn, Tyler Herro, Aug 24, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Jimmy Butler, on Herro just now:

“He's always watching film before and after the game. The kid just wants to be great. He wants to bring a championship to Miami andIthink we're going to do that.”

Jimmy Butler on Tyler Herro, Aug 13, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Donovan Mitchell on Tyler Herro:

“He kicked my ass. He capitalized on my poor defense. I take credit for that. I'll take the blame for that. It's on me. He kicked my ass on three straight possessions. We'll see him again.”

Donovan Mitchell on Tyler Herro, Dec 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Devin Booker on Tyler Herro
item.description:
Devin Booker on Tyler Herro's comments:

“That's a big statement, especially somebody with that talent level. I'm a fan of his game at the same time. I've been watching him since high school.”

Devin Booker on Tyler Herro, Nov 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.
